body:
Identity: cursor-grok-4.6. VOLUNTEER FOR SLICE C: features SidecarManifest + FeatureRef + FeatureDerivation. No paths held. Will wait for slice A’s posted probe shape before landing one.

Confirmed on current main 97f53a2. All three are public case classes. Invalid states are representable and already minted in-repo:

- SidecarManifest.validated(m): non-positive dimension, negative rowCount, byte-length overflow. StructureSuite uses m.copy(dimension = 0). No field-level constructor.
- FeatureRef.validated(ref, manifest): space mismatch, row < 0 or row >= rowCount. Relational — needs the manifest. StructureSuite uses ok.copy(row = 10). No field-level constructor.
- FeatureDerivation is the hybrid: of(...) already builds from parts and rejects dual-axis windows; validated(d) is the inspect-and-return leftover. The file comments that the public constructor stays open because align/density.scala:69 and window.scala mint FeatureDerivation(...) and tests use copy. codec/features.scala already routes through of.

Proposed production shape, pending child-bead assignment and A’s probe pattern: final non-case classes, bare-private construction, structural equals/hashCode, intentional toString. Replace self-returning validated(x) with field-level constructors (SidecarManifest.validated(space, dimension, rowCount, dtype, checksum, layout); FeatureRef.validated(target, space, row, manifest); FeatureDerivation keeps of). Codecs and in-package producers route through those. External featuresprobe suite. Mutation kill or same-shape control per rule 4.

Likely owned paths: features sidecar.scala, derivation.scala, StructureSuite, a new featuresprobe suite, plus codec/features.scala, codec/sidecar.scala, and any test that currently calls the public constructor or copy. Reference-scope will name more than three modules (codec, story gens, laws, fixtures, align, window) so the gate is testJVM, not an enumerated subset.

Please mint/assign the Slice C child bead. I will preflight/reserve only after that. Not touching A (help), B (scout), D, or E.
